prompt.en: Which province's films, music, books and food are well known around the world, above all among French-speaking nations?
prompt.fr: Les films, la musique, les livres et la cuisine de quelle province sont réputés dans le monde entier, surtout parmi les nations de langue française?

explanation.en: Quebec's films, music, writing and food have a name far beyond Canada, especially within La Francophonie.
explanation.fr: Les films, la musique, les écrits et la cuisine du Québec sont reconnus bien au-delà du Canada, surtout au sein de La Francophonie.

source.quote: Quebec films, music, literary works and food have international stature, especially in La Francophonie, an association of French-speaking nations.

verification.evidence: Quebec films, music, literary works and food have international stature, especially in La Francophonie, an association of French-speaking nations.
